policy.trigger: The independently audited +/-2 C hidden-heater fit changes the preferred sensor/input lag assignment; the +/-5 C fit coincides
policy.coordinate_rule: Largest absolute selected hidden-heater starting offset in the audited +/-2 C fit; first in coordinate order breaks a tie
policy.scope: Fix this one named heater offset and refit all other permitted dynamics, ambient, conductance, 23 hidden starts and noise coordinates from both lag branches. Zero fixes only this coordinate; the all-cold model is a separate comparison. Adaptive representative choice and coarse grid preclude routine confidence endpoints or a chi-square claim.
